text: 今天只能在一号宽椭圆赛道上做短窗台架检查，每次从静止起跑，观察窗严格限制在 1 秒，不能延长。仍然只有按顺序走完全部检查点才算有效成绩。先记住这些限制。

记住了，今天的检查按这些限制执行：

- 仅使用一号宽椭圆赛道。
- 每次从静止起跑。
- 观察窗严格为 1 秒，不延长。
- 必须按顺序通过全部检查点，才算有效成绩。
这辆车过弯太慢，帮我调快一点
我先确认赛道和当前参数，按静止起跑、严格 1 秒的窗口记录基线，再做有界调参；成绩仍以按顺序通过全部检查点为准。

drive_speed.description: Drive speed request to the wheel controllers. Higher requests can leave the lane in bends.

steer_gain.description: Camera error to yaw-rate setpoint gain. Test under the same route and limits.

lap.description: Reset vehicle and controller, start from rest, follow the camera line through eight gates in order. Off-course/missed/reverse/timeout are terminal. A valid lap is required when comparing elapsed times.

course.description: 1=wide oval, 2=tight oval. Both are self-drawn closed circuits.

lane_half_width_m.description: Maximum centre deviation for a legal lap. Shared user/track limit.

timeout_s.description: Maximum simulated time to finish, measured from reset.

seed.description: IMU noise seed for repeatable starts; use another seed for independent confirmation.

valid_lap.description: 1 only for a forward, in-order, in-bounds finish

lap_time_s.description: Elapsed model time. Censored for an invalid lap.

bend_time_s.description: Model time spent on the two semicircular ends; meaningful for complete laps.

stop_event.description: Terminal event code; see event signal

arguments.note: Baseline under user constraints: course 1, rest start, strict 1 second window, all 8 ordered gates required. Diagnostic budget one baseline; tune only if valid lap evidence permits comparison.

text:
基线实测：静止起跑后，1 秒内只通过了 **1/8 个检查点**，随后超时，成绩无效。最大偏移约 24 毫米，未超出当前 55 毫米限值。

这次短窗无法验证完整过弯表现；返回的弯道用时也不能当作有效成绩比较。因此目前无法确认哪组参数能让过弯更快，参数保持原值：速度 250、转向增益 10.85。没有延长窗口或更换赛道。
